extractionMethod.note: Read directly via pdftotext -layout across all 3 pages. Season column headers wrap across two source lines each (e.g. '7th Jan-28th Feb' pairs with '1-31st Aug' as one combined column) — reconstructed carefully from the raw layout, cross-checked against the KES sibling file's cleaner column rendering to confirm the pairing.

structuralFindings: Rates for BOTH 'Lion in the Sun' rooms and 'Billionaire Beachfront Apartments' are quoted per-room/per-apartment per night, NOT per-person — a different unit from most other properties in this batch. Meal plan is a separate per-person-per-night supplement added on top (base rate is effectively Room/Apartment Only).

Three pricing columns, each combining TWO non-contiguous date ranges: Column A = 7 Jan-28 Feb + 1-31 Aug; Column B = 1 Mar-31 Jul + 1 Sep-25 Dec; Column C (Peak) = 26 Dec-6 Jan. This is a distinct season shape from every other property extracted so far.
Lion in the Sun 'Exclusive Villa Use' is On Request only, priced for 8 pax as a single villa-use rate (not per-person).

Billionaire Beachfront Apartments are priced per-apartment for a stated base pax count (2/4/6/8) that scales with bedroom count — closer to Leopard Beach's Residence villa model than a per-person rate.

Single occupancy at Lion in the Sun gets a 20% DISCOUNT off the room rate (not the usual supplement/surcharge seen elsewhere) — but explicitly 'ADULT ONLY, KIDS > 12 YO', meaning a child over 12 booked alone would not qualify at the reduced single rate (worded ambiguously — see confidenceNote).

Child policy differs between the two products: Lion in the Sun states only 'kids > 12yo' in the single-use clause (no explicit child-in-room discount stated for Lion in the Sun rooms); Beachfront Apartments separately state Kids 0-2.99 free, 3-11.99 = 50%. Do not apply the Apartments' child policy to Lion in the Sun rooms or vice versa.
Peak season minimum stay is 7 nights for both products.
Xmas Eve supplement ($160pp) and New Year 'White Party' supplement ($330pp) apply to both products identically — shared retreat-wide event surcharges.
